Meaning: The Sun represents your core identity, life force, and conscious will. It shows how you shine and express your ego in the world.
The Moon governs your feelings, instincts, memories, and unconscious needs. It reflects how you nurture and what makes you feel safe.
Mercury rules the mind, learning, speaking, and how you process information. It governs language, thought patterns, and curiosity.
Venus rules love, pleasure, beauty, and what you value in relationships. It shows how you express affection and seek harmony.
Mars governs drive, physical energy, ambition, and sexuality. It shows how you assert yourself and pursue what you want.
Jupiter expands whatever it touches—governing optimism, growth, travel, philosophy, and your pursuit of meaning.
Saturn brings lessons, boundaries, responsibilities, and long-term goals. It tests your resilience and rewards patience.
Uranus disrupts the status quo. It’s about freedom, originality, unexpected events, and technological breakthroughs.
Neptune dissolves boundaries. It rules fantasy, intuition, creativity, and ideals—but can also bring confusion or deception.
Pluto reveals hidden forces. It rules death/rebirth cycles, control, obsession, healing, and deep psychological change.
Chiron shows your deepest wounds and your unique path to healing. Where it lies, there is pain—but also the potential for great wisdom.
Black Moon Lilith represents raw, untamed feminine energy, shadow desires, and themes of rejection and autonomy.
The North Node represents your soul’s evolutionary path forward. The South Node (opposite) shows past-life comfort zones.
Ceres governs care, harvest, motherhood, and nourishment. It shows how you give and receive support—especially physically.
Pallas Athena rules wisdom, patterns, politics, and artistic strategy. She blends intellect with intuition and battle with beauty.
Juno shows your ideal partner, soul contracts, and how you relate in committed unions. She seeks equality and respect.
Vesta represents sacred sexuality, focus, and devotion to a higher calling. It rules rituals, purity, and inner sanctity.
Eris challenges systemic imbalances. She brings chaos that ultimately exposes truth, injustice, and power struggles.
The Ascendant (rising sign) is your outer shell—how you greet the world, initiate action, and are perceived in first impressions.
The Descendant reveals your relational style and the qualities you seek in close partnerships—often a shadow mirror of yourself.
The MC is your professional peak and public persona—your goals, legacy, and role in society.
The IC is your foundation—where you come from emotionally and what 'home' means to you at your core.
